description: Classificació d'aeroports per país, comunitat autònoma i illa (IBESTAT: CL_AEROPUERTOS_ES53) is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto de Estadística de las Islas Baleares (IBESTAT). Classificació que recull els diferents aeroports del món i presenta una composició dividida en 2 grups: Espanya i Resta del món (estrangers). Espanya es divideix d'una banda en Comunitats Autònomes (exclosa Illes Balears) i els seus respectius aeroports i per un altre, Illes Balears i els seus respectius aeroports. Coverage: Instituto de Estadística de las Islas Baleares (IBESTAT). The publisher named on the listing is Instituto de Estadística de las Islas Baleares (IBESTAT). Its keywords include Classificació. The listing shows 5 download or service links in XML, CSV, JSON, SHEET. The listing shows 2025-10-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
